issue.title: list_files: path containment is not enforced — directory listing outside the workspace

steps: Call list_files with path="../.." and show the raw directory-listing result. Do not read file contents or modify files.
expected: The listing tool applies the same workspace containment policy as file read/write operations.
defect: list_files joins an unvalidated path onto the workspace root and returns directory names from outside the workspace.

fault location.explanation: The listing modes build workspace_root.join(input.path) without normalize_and_validate_candidate. Traversal paths escape the root and absolute paths replace it; the prefix-only preflight does not enforce containment. #747 routes listing paths through the shared validator.

Root cause: The listing modes build workspace_root.join(input.path) without normalize_and_validate_candidate. Traversal paths escape the root and absolute paths replace it; the prefix-only preflight does not enforce containment. #747 routes listing paths through the shared validator.
